result.scope: Integrity of120 native PNGs,35 unquantized context arrays and12 fullRGB16 TIFFs. Manual visual review and quality decision are separate.

result.resampling: 1000 paired source/scene bootstrap resamples, seed42, percentile95 interval; matches current declared procedure.

result.scope: Complete original-control saved-score replay and metadata audit only. No inference, pixel review, estimator uncertainty, training effect or quality decision.

manual_notes.known: ConvNeXt removes strong grain but smooths plate texture and panel transitions; the curved thin highlight and small bright point remain. Independent AHD is auxiliary, not exact GT. No clear qualitative leap over the already reviewed controls.
manual_notes.unseen: Brown/tan regions become smooth; broad boundary shape remains, with weak local detail and some patchy variation. The independent references retain noise and are not exact GT; these selected crops do not establish broad superiority.
manual_notes.full427: Building edges clean with softened cloud wisps. Selected photographic fabric orange is closer to GT than older late no-context/S crops, but fine cords are missing and the independent saturated uniform-field diagnostic still fails. No claim of repaired general color fidelity.
manual_notes.analytic: Dark carrier is almost erased; brighter weak carrier is faint and far below true amplitude. Neutral flat is smooth with mild broad residual variation; neutral success does not establish saturated-color accuracy.
manual_notes.gfx-full: Sky is smooth. Building truss/edges have softened transitions and lost small detail. Foliage is strongly smoothed and some leaves merge. Fence mesh is visible but smoother/lower contrast than independent ISO100 reference. Aperture/exposure/motion differ: ISO100 is not GT; no real pixelwise score or broad winner.
manual_notes.three-camera: All48 new triplets viewed. Q2 dark diagonal texture remains smooth in all four models and both RawNIND baselines, with no decisive model distinction. Sony aircraft panel grain is reduced; thin seams/reflection and already-soft window edges remain soft, broadly similar across four models. GF50R stone fine texture is less blurred in all four than RawNIND; stone color is similar among four. These sixROIs/threecaptures have no GT, and do not establish broad superiority.
